production_qualification.scope: Existing production model change qualification, not an academic research study. No Lambda rental or alternative paid provider.
qualitative_findings: Inspected final Flash dossiers against supplied raw captures and retained accepted Pro work: fiscal periods, financial units and primary-versus-secondary source limits remain explicit.
MRNA retains trial endpoints and immature overall survival, avoids treating a procurement maximum as firm backlog, and distinguishes reimbursement benchmarks from realized price.
TEAM distinguishes ARR, RPO, revenue, GAAP/non-GAAP and reported results versus guidance; Data Center security exposure remains separate from unconfirmed Cloud compromise.
XP separates client assets, asset-manager AUM, inflows and revenue; consolidated bank-like liabilities do not become parent-company debt or a cash runway calculation.
Immediate follow-ups now concern currently obtainable evidence. Future earnings releases move to dated next_research_actions after adding the current execution date and the common timing contract.

Read the actual full Pro company narrative produced from the cheaper TEAM dossier. It retains the growth/margin tension, dates, financial observations, source limitations and indirect developer/workforce connections.

semantic_refresh_review.observed: Three duplicate/timestamp-only reports reused; material safety/regulatory developments, earnings update, original-source numeric correction and unresolved material allegation require refresh. Decisions and explanations personally inspected.

limitations: This does not establish equal forecasting accuracy or a full scheduled-job completion. Tomorrow is the owner-authorized monitored candidate with a retained baseline retry.

Two initial Pro replay calls hit the qualification scope's 300-second default. Final qualification uses explicit production-compatible budgets. Existing accepted Pro outputs remain the comparison evidence for those companies.

The first simulated safety event was labeled fictional inside the model input and was correctly ignored as news. Corrected the acceptance fixture, keeping simulation labels outside the supplied scenario; no fixture entered product memory.
An exact XP event-day inference persisted on a repeat despite a general date instruction. Those analytical economy roles are held; full-model dossier interpretation and synthesis are preserved.

decision.reason: XP repeatedly inferred an exact event day from a source publication day, while Pro avoided the unsupported day. Do not keep prompting one case until it passes. Keep substantive financial/regulatory interpretation on full model in the first rollout.
